newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson says inspector certifies victory.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson says inspector certifies victory.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson and Co said the independent inspector appointed by Great Western Financial Corp certified that more than a majority of Great Western shares were voted in favor of its consent proposal requiring Great Western to hold its annual meeting by May 6.
CT Corporation Systems, the independent inspector, also certified two other proposals received the requisite majority to be adopted into Great Western's bylaws, Ahmanson said.

Great Western has said Ahmanson "double counted" votes on some consent proposals. Ahmanson said it offered last Friday to enter a deal to resolve whether Great Western's contention on double counting mattered on any of the proposals.
